title.narrative: NamLITS 2.0 complete and fully operational

description.narrative: Date Process of Initial date was postponed to allow MAWF vets to focus on a suspected outbreak of FMD in the Caprivi (now called Zambezi region). The response to the outbreak required vaccinations at scheduled intervals and on-going testing. DVS decided to ensure that the actions taken during that response (the vaccines and potentially additional animals tagged) are recorded straight away into the NamLITS computer system rather than onto paper for eventual later capture. Since the upgrade to Release 4 would require a few days nationwide downtime AND all the field computers in the North to be sent to Windhoek for approx. 2 weeks, they decided to keep the field computers and get all the data into the system, and then do the upgrade when the outbreak response is complete.
